release_notes: FilePilot v1.2.0 release with custom branded application icon and system tray support
High-contrast White mode (black text) and Deep Navy Blue mode (white text)
Powerful Whole Computer Search across all mounted drives with wildcard and type filters
Native Windows Recycle Bin integration for safe, undoable file deletions
Lag-free directory navigation with smooth 60fps scrolling and lazy view rendering
Aligned Software Update Center with v1.2.0 status badge and changelog
